description: This file defines classes and types related to network requests, responses, and WebSocket handling within the Playwright core library, including request interception, header management, and request/response lifecycle management.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, providing access to request details, headers, response, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response, providing access to response details, headers, body, and security info.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection, handling message events, sending messages, and connection state.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Handles request routing, interception, and fulfillment within the network layer.

classes.name: WebSocketRoute
classes.description: Manages WebSocket route interception and communication between page and server.

classes.name: WebSocketRouteHandler
classes.description: Defines a handler for WebSocket route interception with pattern matching.

classes.name: RouteHandler
classes.description: Manages request/response route handling, including stopping, handling, and expiration.

classes.name: RawHeaders
classes.description: Manages raw HTTP headers, providing methods to access headers in various formats.

methods.name: headersObjectToArray
methods.description: Converts headers object to array format.

methods.name: urlMatches
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches a pattern or regex.

methods.name: isTargetClosedError
methods.description: Determines if an error is due to target closure.

methods.name: rewriteErrorMessage
methods.description: Enhances error messages with additional context.

methods.name: getMimeTypeForPath
methods.description: Returns MIME type based on file path.
